title: My Dear Cabbages! 🥬
message:
I, rawalmond, need your favor!

If you like the app, please take 10 seconds to leave an honest **review**. It really helps!

And if you have any ideas, requests, or thoughts, tell me anytime in **Settings ➔ Feedback**.

Thank you! 💛
— rawalmond

title: 2.7.5 Updates
message:
• Now, you can receive in-app updates! Like this.
